title: cwht Requirements Mapping Matrix (NPR 7150.2D App. C)
description: One row per SWE-NNN requirement that carries an X in the Class A column of NPR 7150.2D Appendix C Table 2. The row set is generated from docs/references/md/npr-7150-2d/09-appendixc.md and cross-checked by tools/render_rmm.py --check; dispositions are authored. Disposition codes: FC fully compliant, T tailored, NA not applicable. Rows dispositioned T or NA carry a tailoring rationale and a residual-risk statement (NPR 7150.2D section 2.2.5 Note: rationale, risk evaluation, supporting material; SWE-126 a.(4)) and are approved by the owner acting as Engineering Technical Authority, SMA Technical Authority, Health and Medical Technical Authority and CIO/SAISO designee (03 sections 6.2 and 7; NPR 7150.2D App. C.3, sections 2.2.1 and 2.2.6), recorded in the review decision memo named in meta.approval.memo.

source_table.description: Corpus file and column the row set was parsed from

software_class_app_d_assessment.description: Where App. D would place the software by the letter; recorded alongside the election

authority.const: Owner as ETA, SMA TA, HMTA and CIO/SAISO designee
authority.description: Capacities in which the owner approves the matrix (03 section 6.2)

memo.description: Decision memo that carries the owner signature block for this RMM version

rows.description: Exactly the 100 Class A rows of NPR 7150.2D App. C Table 2 (count verified against the corpus by tools/render_rmm.py --check and against the [SWE-NNN] tags of chapters 3 to 5). Change these bounds only when the governing NPR revision changes.

npr_section.description: Section number of the requirement in NPR 7150.2D, as printed in Table 2

npr_group.description: Second-level section used for grouping in the rendered matrix

section_title.description: Title of npr_group as printed in Table 2

requirement_text.description: Verbatim requirement statement from the corpus table (NPR 7150.2D App. C.2.c)

authority_npr.description: Authority column of Table 2 for Classes A to E (Center, HQ OSMA, Center and Center CIO, ...)

implementation.description: How cwht satisfies the requirement: artifact path(s) and responsible role per the charter; for NA rows, how the intent is preserved

tailoring_rationale.description: What is relieved and why. Required (non-null) when disposition is T or NA; null when FC

residual_risk.description: Risk evaluation for the relief (NPR 7150.2D section 2.2.5 Note; SWE-126 a.(4)): the accepted residual risk and its mitigation or RSK-NNN link, or the statement that no residual engineering risk exists and how the intent is preserved. Required (non-null) when disposition is T or NA; null when FC

authority.const: Owner as ETA, SMA TA, HMTA and CIO/SAISO designee
authority.description: Capacities in which the owner approves the matrix (03 section 6.2)

enum: Owner (PM, Decision Authority, ETA, SMA TA)

status.description: In place: the requirement is satisfied today by artifacts that exist in the repository. Planned: satisfaction needs an artifact or an execution that does not yet exist, named in implementation either as an absent repository path or with the label 'Planned for <gate>'. tools/render_rmm.py enforces the rule (03 section 6.3)

charter_ref.description: Charter section(s) that govern this row
